name: Timeless Witness — mandatory return and eternalize
description: Cast the hand copy using four Forests, then choose Mind Stone in your own graveyard for its mandatory enters trigger; a noncreature card is legal, while the opponent's graveyard is not. The second copy in your graveyard has a sorcery-speed Eternalize action. Seven remaining Forests pay its cost; that copy is exiled immediately, and the resulting black 4/4 Zombie Human Shaman token copies the enters trigger to return Grizzly Bears. The opponent can respond to the ability with Stifle, but cannot undo the exile paid as a cost.
